description:
The Scheme for Adolescent Girls in Bihar was launched in 2010 as a part of the National Mission for Empowerment of Women. 

This initiative aims to address the nutritional and health needs of adolescent girls aged between 11 to 19 years. 

The scheme specifically targets girls who are out of school and focuses on their overall development. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to improve the nutritional status of adolescent girls. 

The scheme also aims to provide them with life skills education and vocational training. 

The government has set a measurable target of reaching approximately 1.5 million adolescent girls under this scheme in Bihar. 

The scheme seeks to reduce the prevalence of anemia among adolescent girls by providing them with iron and folic acid supplements. 

The initiative also aims to increase awareness regarding health and hygiene practices. 

Financial assistance is provided to beneficiaries in the form of a monthly stipend. 

Each eligible girl receives a stipend of INR 500 per month. 

This financial support is intended to encourage girls to pursue education and vocational training. 

The eligibility criteria for the scheme include being a resident of Bihar. 

Applicants must be aged between 11 to 19 years. 

The scheme is specifically designed for girls who are not enrolled in school. 

There is no specific income limit set for eligibility. 

However, priority is given to girls from economically weaker sections of society. 

To apply for the scheme, interested candidates must follow a specific application process. 

The first step is to visit the local Anganwadi center in their area. 

Applicants must fill out a registration form provided by the Anganwadi worker. 

Required documents include proof of age such as a birth certificate or school leaving certificate. 

Additionally, applicants may need to provide proof of residence. 

Once the application is submitted, the Anganwadi worker verifies the details. 

After verification, eligible girls are enrolled in the scheme. 

The scheme also includes regular health check-ups for beneficiaries. 

These health check-ups are conducted at the local health centers. 

The frequency of these check-ups is typically every six months. 

The scheme promotes awareness about health issues such as menstrual hygiene. 

Workshops and training sessions are organized to educate girls about personal hygiene. 

The scheme also includes vocational training programs. 

These programs are designed to equip girls with skills for employment. 

The vocational training covers various sectors such as tailoring, beauty care, and handicrafts. 

The duration of vocational training programs varies from three to six months. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Bihar. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the implementation and monitoring of the scheme. 

Local Anganwadi workers play a crucial role in the execution of the scheme. 

They are responsible for identifying eligible girls and facilitating their enrollment. 

The scheme has received significant funding from the central government. 

In the financial year 2022-2023, the government allocated INR 150 crores for the implementation of this scheme. 

The scheme also collaborates with various NGOs for effective outreach. 

These NGOs assist in conducting awareness programs and workshops. 

The impact of the scheme is monitored through regular assessments. 

The government conducts surveys to evaluate the nutritional status of beneficiaries. 

As of 2023, the scheme has successfully enrolled over 1 million girls in Bihar. 

The initiative has contributed to a noticeable decrease in anemia rates among adolescent girls. 

The scheme also encourages community participation. 

Local communities are engaged in promoting the importance of education for girls. 

The government has also launched awareness campaigns through social media. 

These campaigns aim to reach a wider audience and encourage more girls to enroll. 

The scheme is part of a larger framework of initiatives aimed at empowering women in Bihar. 

This includes programs focused on education, health, and economic empowerment. 

The government is committed to improving the status of women and girls in the state. 

In conclusion, the Scheme for Adolescent Girls in Bihar is a comprehensive initiative. 

It focuses on the nutritional, educational, and vocational needs of adolescent girls. 

The scheme has made significant strides in improving the lives of many girls in the state. 

With continued support and implementation, it aims to empower more adolescent girls in Bihar. 

The scheme represents a crucial step towards achieving gender equality in the region. 

The government remains dedicated to enhancing the welfare of adolescent girls through this initiative. 

Overall, the Scheme for Adolescent Girls in Bihar is an essential program. 

It addresses critical issues faced by adolescent girls and provides them with necessary support. 

The initiative is a testament to the government's commitment to women's empowerment in India.
